node: Travel and housing transaction infrastructure: property-management systems, channel managers, revenue-management software, mortgage/insurance workflows, and maintenance networks
summary: Expanded the node around operational-complexity beneficiaries rather than headline consumer demand. The most relevant US-listed discovery candidates are vertical workflow/software names serving hospitality, home services, mortgage origination, inspection/title/roofing, and homeowners insurance workflows. The underfollowed angle is that these companies often screen as software, insurance, real estate services, or SMB SaaS rather than consumer travel/housing beneficiaries. Evidence quality is mixed: Agilysys has the clearest direct hospitality infrastructure fit; EverCommerce and Porch are adjacent home-services/workflow networks; Blend is a cyclical but direct mortgage workflow platform. No trading recommendation is made.
